answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 7234 Country: United Kingdom Title: Can you please tell me what it means if someone has dreams about having intercourse with one's sister? Question: Can you please tell me what it means if someone has dreams about having intercourse with one's sister? Answer ID: 7234 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1412/1327=D/1429) It indicates that he should have good conduct with his sister and treat her well. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
